svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.28.6.4 Second Coat
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.28 STUCCO

g.text: Second coat, finish other than stone dash

svg.text: The second coat is not less than 6 mm (¼″)
The surface of the second coat is lightly
roughened to provide a key with the finish
coat if the finish coat is other than stone
Second coat drawn at the 6 mm minimum, measured from the face of the first coat. Roughening and stone sizes are schematic.
